description.en: SCR-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating security risks in composed LLM agent skill workflows. It includes three sub-benchmarks (SCR-CapFlow, SCR-TrustLift, SCR-AuthBlur) that measure attack success rates, trust transfer, and authorization confusion in sandboxed environments.

claire_radar.motivation: Skills are becoming the capability layer through which LLM agents turn plans into actions, but their use introduces security risks such as data leakage, unauthorized operations, and tool misuse.

claire_radar.paperTitle: Benign in Isolation, Harmful in Composition: Security Risks in Agent Skill Ecosystems

source.title: Benign in Isolation, Harmful in Composition: Security Risks in Agent Skill Ecosystems

claire_radar.whyItMatters: SCR-Bench addresses the gap in evaluating agent skill security at the path level, where skills benign in isolation become harmful in composition. It provides a controlled, sandboxed environment for assessing composition-induced risks.
